modules.name: Optics
modules.description: Optics and photonics: light and photons, geometric optics, diffraction, Gaussian beams, cavities and etalons, fibers, frequency combs, detection and materials, with the optics tools and material data. Version 1.1 adds formulas following Saleh & Teich’s Fundamentals of Photonics (rays to ultrafast optics) and Neamen’s Semiconductor Physics and Devices (carriers, junctions, transistors, optical devices). Every formula solves for any of its variables.

modules.name: Machinist
modules.description: Shop tools for machinists: speeds and feeds, thread pitch and tap drills, number, letter, fractional and metric drills with their metric and inch sizes, clearance holes, shop calculators, and a G-code and M-code reference.

modules.name: Periodic Table
modules.description: All 118 elements: tap one for its mass, configuration, electronegativity, radii, ionization energies, melting and boiling points, density, discovery and isotopes. Colour the table by category, block, state or a property, and work out the molar mass of a formula.

modules.name: Computer Science
modules.description: IPv4 and IPv6 subnetting (CIDR, VLSM, summaries), bits and bytes, storage sizes in decimal (kB, MB, GB) and binary (KiB, MiB, GiB) units, data rates and transfer times, RAID and ZFS layouts (capacity, efficiency, fault tolerance and speed), number bases and bitwise operations, and tables: CIDR masks, special address ranges, ports, ASCII, powers of 2, integer and floating-point formats, algorithm complexity and HTTP status codes.

modules.name: Example module
modules.description: One of each kind of item a CalcShelf module can hold. Copy this file to start your own module.
